mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and reducing the present value of future equity cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 50,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below -10,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer and business confidence, lowering S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% for 3 consecutive months signals robust supply-side demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below -1.5% for 3 consecutive months signals weak supply-side demand, which compresses corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3% for 3 consecutive months signals supply-side inflation pressures, which compresses discount rates and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decrease in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below -0.2% for 3 consecutive months signals deflationary pressures, which increases the present value of future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in deflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
